question: Do s011 in-basin landings render Band A in hi-fi, and are seed-10's competing basins observationally indistinguishable from truth (multi-solution) or visibly worse (failure)?
hypothesis: In-basin landings are Band A under hi-fi; seed-10's competing basins are either multi-solution (any ρ<4) or a genuine failure (all ρ≥4).
narrative_md: Hi-fi ρ-band of s011/s012a candidates. Cohort A (36 in-basin landings): all Band A, ρ 0.04-0.23, median 0.078 — surrogate-MSE convergence matches hi-fi ρ<1 cleanly. Cohort B (seed 10, N=256): A=0, B=2, C=132, D=122; best ρ=3.90 (Band B); surrogate↔hi-fi Spearman 0.999; surrogate-best == hi-fi-best (IC#6). DECISION: MULTI_SOLUTION (2/256 candidates ρ<4). Greedy 5° clustering yields 158 distinct attractors.
